ns2:course.label: Linguistic Anth-ACP
ns2:course.description: Course is identical to ANTH 270 except for the additional writing component. Credit is not given for both ANTH 271 and ANTH 270. Prerequisite: ANTH 103 or ANTH 104 or LING 100 or consent of instructor; completion of campus Composition I general education requirement.
